data.description:
# Preserve WAV fallback and handle missing synth factories

## Goal
Guarantee audio never breaks: the WAV/Phaser fallback works when ToneForge is genuinely unavailable or toggled off, and synth-mapped keys with no matching factory fall back to WAV rather than going silent.

## Context
`MAIN_STREET_TF_SFX_MAPPING` has 16 entries but the runtime module exports only 12 factories. `sfx-income-positive` -> `income-positive-chime`, `sfx-income-negative` -> `income-negative-chime`, `sfx-income-neutral` -> `income-neutral-chime`, and `sfx-challenge-complete` -> `success-fanfare` have no factory. `SoundManager.play()` returns early after calling `synthPlayer.play()`, and `tfAdapter` only warns on a missing factory, so these keys are silent instead of falling back.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. When ToneForge is unavailable, mapped keys play via the WAV/Phaser path.
2. When ToneForge is toggled off via the debug tool (companion item), playback reverts to WAV with no scene restart.
3. A synth-mapped key whose factory is missing falls back to WAV (or the mapping/adaptor is fixed so no silent drop remains); tests cover this.
4. Mute/volume and reduced-motion/accessibility settings are unaffected.

## Minimal Implementation
- Write tests first for: unavailable module, toggled-off, missing factory.
- Decide the missing-factory policy (fallback in `tfAdapter`/`SoundManager`, or remove/align the four mapping entries) and implement the smallest change.
- Add a test for mute/volume preservation.

## Dependencies
Fix runtime wiring item (for the active-but-missing-factory case). The unavailable/toggled-off cases can be tested independently.

## Deliverables
Tests (+ small code fix in tfAdapter/SoundManager or the mapping).
